exposure: prenatal and early life bacterial colonisation
cohort: Pregnant women with and without IBD and their babies
finding: Maternal IBD was associated with lower bacterial diversity and altered composition in both mothers and their infants, and these alterations were linked to abnormal immune system development in germ-free mice.
mod_finding: While the study examined the impact of maternal IBD on infant microbiome, mode of delivery itself was not a primary focus.
